name: Visionary
description: The Visionary was the elegant cloaked transport of G0-T0, one of the most successful Exchange bosses operating in both the Y'Toub system and Republic space. It was probably one of a kind, in that its actual owner was a droid, as was its entire crew. It was destroyed by the Jedi Exile in the Mission to Nar Shaddaa.

data.name: Visionary
data.armament: Dual Turbolaser turrets (2 on the ventre, 2 under and over both wings, 6 in total)
